description: Metric unit conversions for length (km, m, cm, mm), mass/weight (kg, g), capacity (L, mL), balance scale weighing, and real-life measurement problems.
learningObjectives: Convert larger metric units into smaller units by multiplying by 100, 1000
Convert smaller metric units into larger units by dividing
Solve mass balancing scale weight challenges
Calculate container liquid capacities in liters and milliliters
